name: ORDER_RESULTING_METRICS
description: This table contains information about how your procedural orders were resulted.

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) of the order record associated with this procedure order.

columns.name: TEXT_GENERATION_COUNT
columns.description: The count of text generation statements used for study findings.

columns.name: TEXT_GENERATION_EDIT_COUNT
columns.description: The count of edited text generation statements used for study findings. This is only possible with compact forms.

columns.name: SUMMARY_STMT_ACTIVE_AUTO_COUNT
columns.description: The count of active automatic summary statements generated from study findings and not removed by user.

columns.name: SUMMARY_STMT_AUTO_COUNT
columns.description: The count of automatic summary statements generated from study findings.

columns.name: SUMMARY_STMT_ACTIVE_EDIT_COUNT
columns.description: The count of active edited summary statements that were not removed by the user.

columns.name: SUMMARY_STMT_EDIT_COUNT
columns.description: The count of edited summary statements.

columns.name: FINDINGS_SDE_COUNT
columns.description: The count of SmartData elements documented on study findings.

columns.name: INTRA_FINDINGS_INCLUDED_COUNT
columns.description: The count of SmartData elements recorded by intraprocedural findings events in the procedural narrator that are included in final report.

columns.name: INTRA_FINDINGS_REMOVED_COUNT
columns.description: The count of SmartData elements recorded by intraprocedural findings events in the procedural narrator excluded from the final report.

columns.name: VESSEL_ANNOTATION_COUNT
columns.description: The count of vessel annotations documented in Study Review.

columns.name: COMPACT_FORM_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether the order has been resulted with a Compact Form in Study Review.

columns.name: MEASUREMENT_COUNT
columns.description: The count of result components on the order.

columns.name: CALCULATED_MEASUREMENT_COUNT
columns.description: The count of calculated result components on the order.

columns.name: XML_MEASUREMENT_COUNT
columns.description: The count of measurements exchanged with measurement exchange on the order.

columns.name: MODIFIED_XML_MEASUREMENT_COUNT
columns.description: The count of exchanged measurements that were modified on the order.

columns.name: ORDER_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The order type category number for the procedure order.

columns.name: RADIOLOGY_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the imaging status of the study.

columns.name: ACTV_EXCLUDE_FROM_CDS_REASON_C_NAME
columns.description: The Exclude From Decision Support reason for the order. It will be either 1 - Unsuccessful Attempt represents an order that was not successfully completed. or 2 - Documented on Wrong Patient represents the order's result information was documented on the incorrect patient.

columns.name: TOTAL_STUDY_RVW_TIME
columns.description: Total time study review was open for the study.

columns.name: FINAL_PHYS_STUDY_RVW_TIME
columns.description: Total time study review was open by the finalizing physician.

columns.name: READ_PHYS_STUDY_RVW_TIME
columns.description: Total time study review was open by reading physicians who are not the finalizing physician.

columns.name: NON_READ_USER_STUDY_RVW_TIME
columns.description: Total time study review was open by all users not listed as a reading physician.

columns.name: FINAL_PHYS_SDE_COUNT
columns.description: Total number of SmartData elements documented on study findings by the finalizing physician.

columns.name: READ_PHYS_SDE_COUNT
columns.description: Total number of SmartData elements documented on study findings by reading physicians who are not the finalizing physician.

columns.name: NON_READ_USER_SDE_COUNT
columns.description: Total number of SmartData elements documented on study findings by all users not listed as a reading physician.
